tagline.en: X-VLA — a cross-embodiment vision-language-action policy that drives many different robots from one model family.
tagline.zh: X-VLA——一个跨形态的视觉-语言-动作策略，用同一套模型家族驱动多种不同机器人。

en: X-VLA is a vision-language-action (VLA) model for robot control, built on a Florence-2 vision-language backbone with a soft-prompted transformer and dedicated action transforms. From camera images and a task, it predicts the robot's next actions.

Its defining feature is cross-embodiment: rather than one policy per robot, X-VLA ships a set of checkpoints tuned to specific embodiments and benchmarks — WidowX, Google Robot, LIBERO, CALVIN ABC->D, RoboTwin2, VLABench, AGIWorld, and a soft-fold cloth task — plus a foundation checkpoint for further use. Each checkpoint is bound to its embodiment through an explicit domain ID, and the model emits action chunks for closed-loop rollout.

In WorldFoundry you run X-VLA through the shared policy interface: pick the checkpoint that matches your robot or benchmark, provide the domain ID (required for the foundation checkpoint), and step the policy in a simulator or on hardware. Inference runs in float32 by default, with bf16/fp16 available as performance options.
zh: X-VLA 是用于机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，基于 Florence-2 视觉语言骨干，配合软提示 transformer 与专用的动作变换。它从相机图像和任务出发，预测机器人的下一步动作。

它最鲜明的特点是跨形态：X-VLA 不是每个机器人配一个策略，而是提供一组针对具体形态与基准调优的 checkpoint——WidowX、Google Robot、LIBERO、CALVIN ABC->D、RoboTwin2、VLABench、AGIWorld，以及一个软折叠布料任务——外加一个可继续使用的基础 checkpoint。每个 checkpoint 通过显式的 domain ID 绑定到其形态，模型输出用于闭环 rollout 的动作块。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一的策略接口运行 X-VLA：选一个匹配你的机器人或基准的 checkpoint，提供 domain ID（基础 checkpoint 必填），然后在仿真或真机上逐步执行策略。推理默认使用 float32，也可选 bf16/fp16 以提升性能。

whenToUse.en: Reach for X-VLA when you need a single VLA family that transfers across robots and standard manipulation benchmarks — pick the embodiment-matched checkpoint and roll out the policy in sim or on real hardware.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个能跨机器人和标准操作基准迁移的 VLA 家族时，选用 X-VLA——挑一个与形态匹配的 checkpoint，在仿真或真机上执行策略 rollout。

notFor.en: It's an action policy, not a video or world generator. Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled, and the foundation checkpoint won't run without an explicit domain ID.
notFor.zh: 它是动作策略，而非视频或世界生成器。Checkpoint 需单独下载而非随附，且基础 checkpoint 必须提供显式 domain ID 才能运行。

en: Cross-embodiment VLA: one family across many robots and benchmarks
Florence-2 backbone with a soft-prompted transformer and action transforms
Nine checkpoints covering WidowX, Google Robot, LIBERO, CALVIN, RoboTwin2, VLABench, AGIWorld, soft-fold, plus a foundation model
float32 by default, with bf16/fp16 as performance options
zh: 跨形态 VLA：一个家族覆盖多种机器人与基准
Florence-2 骨干，配合软提示 transformer 与动作变换
九个 checkpoint，涵盖 WidowX、Google Robot、LIBERO、CALVIN、RoboTwin2、VLABench、AGIWorld、软折叠，以及一个基础模型
默认 float32，可选 bf16/fp16 以提升性能
